limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The construction-specific contribution is the faithful midpoint family and the exact distance formula dist(omega_{c,t},T_qd(A))=c|2t-1|. The weak-star diagonal approximation, the complementary-projection norm calculation, and faciality of amenable traces are standard ingredients. The result is specific to Moradi's arXiv:2609.18793v1 algebra and does not classify all quasidiagonal traces or all failures of faciality. Older quasidiagonal-trace literature was not exhaustively checked for an abstract equivalent convex-geometric lemma.
record_title: Faithful quasidiagonal midpoints with an exact norm-distance profile
